[NSTG.7.1] Per IERR.2.7 the storage code range:

| Code | Cause |
|---|---|
| `DS_ERR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE` | NULL cb registered (engine-emitted) OR backend unreachable from cb (integrator-emitted) |
| `DS_ERR_STORAGE_QUERY_FAILED` | backend executed the query but returned an error |
| `DS_ERR_STORAGE_NOT_FOUND` | backend reported "no such key" (distinguishable from generic NOT_FOUND) |
